name: Your Digital Cookbook
detailed_description:
Do you want to master the art of cooking while having fun? Our game is the perfect blend of entertainment and education, designed for everyone—from complete beginners to seasoned home chefs!

🔪 Cook Like a Pro – Follow step-by-step, highly realistic recipes that you can recreate in your own kitchen.

🔥 Challenge Yourself – Choose from five difficulty levels, from simple meals to advanced dishes that will test your precision and timing.

🏆 Get Rated on Your Cooking Skills – Every dish is judged based on how well you prepare, cook, and present it. Can you earn the perfect score?

🎮 Engaging Gameplay, Real-Life Learning – Learn essential cooking techniques, proper ingredient handling, and time management while having a blast.

🌎 A Sustainable Kitchen – Watch out for food waste, water usage, and even energy consumption! Leaving the fridge open or running the tap too long could cost you valuable points.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 For Everyone – Whether you struggle with everyday cooking tasks or just want a more enjoyable way to learn, this game makes the kitchen a fun and stress-free place.

Are you ready to sharpen your skills, experiment with flavors, and become a cooking master? Your journey starts here!

KEY FEATURES

🍳 Realistic Cooking Mechanics – Turn on the tap, fill a pot, and boil water just like in a real kitchen.

🔪 Precision Cutting – Slice and dice vegetables with full control over how you prepare your ingredients.

🔥 Dynamic Cooking System – Cook food to perfection—or completely burn it if you're not careful!

📦 Interactive Ingredients – Open packaging, handle raw ingredients, and prepare everything from scratch.

🍝 Pasta Perfection – Boil pasta with real-time water physics and cooking reactions.

💥 Breakable Kitchen Items – Handle your tools with care, or risk dropping and breaking them!

♻️ Recycle & Manage Waste – Sort trash correctly to earn points and keep your kitchen clean.

🏆 Skill-Based Scoring – Your performance is rated on technique, timing, and execution—strive for mastery!

🌎 Sustainability Matters – Don’t waste ingredients, leave the fridge open, or let water run too long, or it’ll cost you points.

🎮 Multiple Difficulty Levels – From beginners to pros, choose your challenge level and improve your cooking skills step by step.

🥇 More Than a Game – Learn real-life cooking techniques and recipes that you can recreate in your own kitchen!

short_description: An interactive cookbook, where you learn everything you need to know to cook food even if you've never been in a kitchen before. With our real life recipies and realistic execution of the steps you can both play the game for fun or play it as you cook the same recipie in real life.
